caption: Agro-ecological attainable yield, average of best occuring suitability class (Global - 20 years average - ~10 km) - GAEZ v5
description:
Agro-ecological attainable yield results are represented as the average attainable yield of best occurring suitability class in grid cell, expressed as Kg (DW)/ha, with a spatial resolution of approximately 10 km. They account for both rain-fed and irrigated conditions, as well as two different levels of input management (high and low). These results are provided for 52 major crops and cover all soil groups identified by the Harmonized World Soil Database (HWSD v2) (FAO & IIASA, 2023). Agro-ecological attainable yield is estimated using different climate data sources for both historical and future periods.is estimated using different climate data sources for both historical and future periods.

Historical climate data is sourced from AgERA5 from the Copernicus program, covering the periods 1981–2000 and 2001–2020.

For future projections, climate model outputs from the latest CMIP6 IPCC AR6 are used, based on three Shared Socioeconomic Pathways (SSPs) and spanning four time periods: 2021–2040, 2041–2060, 2061–2080, and 2081–2100.

This dataset is part of the GAEZ v5 Suitability and Attainable Yield theme and Agro-Ecological Attainable Yield sub-theme.

For additional information, please refer to the GAEZ v5 Model Documentation (accessible at https://github.com/un-fao/gaezv5/wiki).
